policy_clarification: READY means review-ready only, never post-ready.
Generated or shop-derived images must be reviewed for realism and product plausibility before recurring use.
Images that read as ads, pasted product cutouts, or mismatched visuals should be rejected or replaced.
No posting, upload_media, create_tweet, tracking_code generation, or issue creation should occur without explicit human approval.
